design_evidence_scope.baseline: Human mobile Episode 6 reached an admitted AI answer but lost task/answer continuity, nearly missed result disclosures, and abandoned at the Loom-to-Marrowline import membrane before usable Phase 2 interaction.
design_evidence_scope.comparison: The proposed route is a declared design candidate derived from the bounded Episode 6 observations. It is not a measured human improvement.
design_evidence_scope.millipoint_basis: Route-burden values encode declared structural burden for Pedagogue comparison only; they are not participant scores.
design_evidence_scope.gate_limit: Pedagogue may compare route structure and propose questions; only a later human production episode can establish repair effect.

evidence_basis: The human operator nearly passed the task textarea while searching for the input surface because the loaded task read like explanatory prose.
After a successful AI return the operator had to recover the original task and reported confusion among project/task/answer/result/pocket/packet labels.
The operator nearly missed hidden primary-analysis content and additional detail drawers.
The operator selected the prominent Marrowline continuation action, encountered the import membrane, could not find the route into the ordinary living-chat surface, and closed the tab.
transformations: Keep Project Brief in place but visually subordinate it to an unmistakable task work surface.
Bind the returned answer visibly back to the exact submitted task and contract the human-facing vocabulary.
Keep the complete primary answer in one continuous reading path; place optional next action and technical details after it.
Use explicit plus/minus disclosure affordances for optional details.
Keep provider provenance in technical records while using provider-neutral human-facing product language.
Render imported Loom context as a compact dismissible card inside current Marrowline living chat instead of hiding the chat behind a replacement membrane.

visible_condition.plain_language: See the exact task that will be sent, run it, read one clearly bounded AI answer, then continue in the visible Marrowline chat without losing the task or custody facts.
visible_condition.now: A human has already demonstrated that successful provider return can still end in Phase-1 abandonment.
visible_condition.why: The next design must reduce interpretive work at the task, answer, disclosure, and continuation boundaries without hiding custody facts.
visible_condition.exact: Episode 6 is preserved as the observed baseline; the proposed repair remains a design candidate until a new human episode tests it.

available_affordances.purpose: Run the exact visible task, inspect the admitted answer, and choose an explicit Marrowline continuation gesture.
available_affordances.irreversible_consequence: Selected documents are transmitted when Run is pressed; later navigation cannot recall that transmission.

route_topology.entry: Compact project context followed immediately by an unmistakable editable task surface
route_topology.exit: Rest, return to Loom, close imported context, or continue in ordinary Marrowline chat
missing_inputs: Repaired human Episode 7 has not yet occurred.

steps.label: See compact project context and the exact editable instruction the AI will receive
Run the visible task with one explicit gesture
Read the full primary AI answer beside a compact reminder of what was asked
Optionally open questions, source claims, or the technical receipt with explicit plus/minus controls
Arrive in current Marrowline with its composer visible and Loom context as a compact dismissible card
Rest, leave, or continue while the prior task remains inspectable

causal_structure.input: One human-visible task, selected documents, local-only documents, and explicit run gesture
causal_structure.operator: task salience -> deliberate send -> admitted answer bound back to task -> optional details -> visible Marrowline continuation
causal_structure.observable: The same task remains visible as the answer arrives; the ordinary Marrowline composer remains visible when imported context arrives.
causal_structure.authority: Provider output supplies content only; the human owns send, continuation, dismissal, rest, and exit gestures.

research_frame.question: Can the repaired route preserve custody while reducing the interpretive labor that caused Episode-6 Phase-1 abandonment?
research_frame.hypothesis: Task-surface salience, lexical contraction, one continuous primary answer, and a non-blocking Marrowline import card should reduce structural route burden without removing custody facts.
observable_behavior: The exact task is visibly recognizable as an editable work surface before Run.
The returned answer visibly names the submitted task without requiring backward navigation.
Primary answer text is complete before any optional next-action or technical drawer.
Result disclosures advertise open/closed state with explicit plus/minus affordances.
Marrowline’s ordinary composer remains visible while imported Loom context is present.
falsifier: The task still reads as passive explanatory prose on the narrow viewport.
A user must navigate backward to discover what the answer responded to.
Primary answer content remains hidden behind an easily missed disclosure before a next-step block.
The Marrowline import still replaces or hides the ordinary living-chat workspace.
Human-facing copy centers a provider brand as the identity of the product route.
abstention_conditions: No repaired human episode has yet tested the candidate.
Machine canaries remain machine evidence and cannot establish comprehension.
alternative_explanations: A later human success could reflect greater familiarity rather than the repair alone.
A single human mobile episode cannot establish universal newcomer behavior.
expected_failure_modes: Visual hierarchy still makes context look more important than the action surface.
Synonymous product nouns reappear around the answer.
Optional details visually compete with the primary answer.
Imported context preserves every custody fact by becoming another blocking membrane.

allowed_claims: Episode 6 establishes a bounded human abandonment point after successful provider return.
Pedagogue may compare the declared baseline and candidate route structures.
A later human episode may measure whether behavior changes after intervention.
forbidden_claims: Pedagogue PASS proves the UX repair works for humans.
Machine browser success counts as human replication.
Engineering closure earns a scientific 𝄐 or the Golden Egg.

baseline_route_steps.label: Read a visually dominant Project Brief
Infer that a large prose-like block is the editable task
Navigate backward to remember what the AI was asked
Distinguish primary answer from hidden analysis, next step, open questions, sources, and receipt
Choose the visually dominant Marrowline continuation action
Decode a replacement import membrane and discover how to expose ordinary Marrowline chat
Close the tab after failing to locate the intended continuation

causal_trace: Observed baseline: provider return succeeded but task memory and answer hierarchy fractured.
Observed baseline: import membrane caused human abandonment before usable Marrowline interaction.
Declared candidate: make the task visually unmistakable and bind the answer back to it.
Declared candidate: keep primary answer continuous and optional details subordinate.
Declared candidate: preserve current Marrowline living chat while showing Loom context as a compact dismissible card.
missingness: No post-repair human behavior has yet been observed.
unresolved_relations: The amount of behavioral improvement attributable to the candidate remains unknown.

static_equivalent.summary: Task, answer, optional details, continuation context, rest, and exit remain legible without motion.

name.plain_language: The repair keeps the question and answer together, reduces extra names, and lets Marrowline remain visibly Marrowline during continuation.
non_equivalence: imported context differs from replacement workspace
technical provenance differs from human-facing product identity
optional details differ from primary answer

context.realization: Episode-6 human baseline observed; repair candidate awaiting implementation and Episode-7 human observation.

transfer_context.shared_relation_candidate: Custody can remain inspectable while the human route contracts around one task, one answer, and one visible conversational continuation.
observable_correspondence: The Episode-6 abandonment occurred after provider success, isolating post-return continuity as an independently consequential route segment.
alternative_explanations: A later success could reflect operator familiarity or changed pacing rather than the repair alone.
abstention_conditions: No claim of repaired human comprehension before a new human production episode.

interface_specimen.surface_reference: Holonomy Loom Episode-6 mobile task/composer field
